params.model: PCA factors + OLS bridge, separate model per within-quarter vintage
params.target_definition: derived chain-linked single-quarter real GDP YoY, percent

pca.selection: inner expanding-window CV, pooled M1/M2/M3 RMSE, smallest r on ties

params.benchmark: random walk with training-window drift; historical mean secondary

target_checks.unit_note: gdp_abs_cum_bn is RMB 100 million (亿元); target is in percent
target_checks.note: Derived chain-linked single-quarter volume estimate, not an official separately published NBS single-quarter series.
